scientific_limitations: The affine-regression equivalence needs the displayed absolute first-moment condition; no claim for arbitrary infinite-mean spectra. Conditional regression is unique in slope only for nonzero Thorin measure. Spectral inversion concerns the Lévy measure, not a finite sample. Broader historical priority cannot be exhaustively certified.
title: Spectral balance and affine regression in canonical Thorin couplings
